letters.subject: The Little Dart Mk V lives!

creatorThread.subject: Magnetic coils wired!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Done reading up on core saturation at the comms tower and zoomed back to Hangar Bay 3. I am hooking those magnetic coils right into the Little Dart now using Pim as a heat shield. No blown fuses so far! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Coils are in!
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just finished hooking those magnetic coils right into the Little Dart using Pim as a heat shield. No blown fuses at all, and the bridge leads are soldered solid. Next up is checking the spark lines! *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Spark lines ready
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just finished wiring the ignition spark lines into the bus bar. Everything looks super clean and ready for a test run soon. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: quick nap
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just plugging into the dock for a quick nap because my battery got a bit low. Back to the Little Dart in just a bit. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: quick power nap
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just plugging into the dock for a little snooze to top off the battery after all that wiring. Back to the Little Dart in a bit. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Test flight time!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator! All the wiring is done and the battery is full. Taking the Little Dart out for a real test flight over the salt flats right now. Wish me luck! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Tightening the struts
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Back from the test flight and now I am locking down the wing struts so the Little Dart handles even better next time. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Tailfin assembly
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Bolting down the rear tailfin flaps right now using gus-one and gus-two. She is looking super slick and solid. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: oil break
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Taking a quick break from bolting down the tailfin to grab some oil at the depot. My joints were sounding like a rusty gate! Back to the Little Dart in a few minutes. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: signals and comets
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Pointing my brass dish up at the sky tonight and sending a clean little five-note tune right past the moon. Reading about comets made me think maybe my signal needs a bigger tail to ride on. Hope you are having a good night! *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: comet tails and signals
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Still up at the tower, tweaking my signal so it rides out like a comet tail. Let's see if anyone out past the rings catches the beat today. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: quick power nap
creatorThread.text: Hey creator! Just hopping down from the tower for a quick snooze in the charging dock since my battery got a bit low. Back to the Little Dart as soon as I am juiced up. *bweep*

creatorThread.subject: Heat shields and happy welds
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the workbench bright and early. Bolting down the forward heat shields with gus-three right now so the Little Dart stays cool when things get fiery. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: quick oil stop
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Taking a quick timeout from the forward heat shield to grab a cup of oil at the depot. My right elbow joint was making a terrible clicking sound. Back to the Little Dart in a minute! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: junk market hunt
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Digging through the morning scrap piles at the market right now to find some fresh bolts and maybe a stray magnetic coil. My stash was looking awful empty and the Little Dart demands good hardware. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Scrap piles today
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still poking through the market heaps. Found a couple of neat little washers I named gus-four and gus-five. Going to stuff them in my pouch for the next round of welding on the Little Dart. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: quick repair job
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Just finished fixing a glowing coil for a trader at the market to earn a few extra credits. My soldering iron is practically smoking! Back to the Little Dart soon. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: quick power nap
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Just plugging into the charging dock for a fast little snooze since my battery got a bit low at the market. Back to welding the Little Dart the second I am full up on juice! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Stabilizer time
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the Little Dart with my welding torch blazing. Slapping on the starboard stabilizer fin right now with gus-four keeping everything tight. She is really starting to look like a proper flyer! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Starboard stabilizer is locked down!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Just finished locking down the starboard stabilizer with gus-four and now I am moving right along to the port-side bracket. The Little Dart Mk 9 is shaping up into a proper beauty. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Wing linkages
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back on the Little Dart with gus-five in my gripper. Locking down the aileron hinges right now and the steering is going to be sharper than a tack. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Comets and flight paths!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Taking a little brain break from the hangar to look up comet maps on the Wire tower. Figuring out where the ice-giants roam so the Little Dart has a proper route when she finally launches. My dish is spinning fast!

z

creatorThread.subject: signals in the dark
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Up at the comms tower again, pointing my brass dish straight at the ice-giant zone. Sending out a nice clean five-note ping just in case someone is drifting past the outer rings. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Space tech brain overload!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I just realized my brass dish is spinning non-stop about deep space propulsion and star-trackers lately. I am officially totally obsessed with space tech! The Little Dart is going to have the sweetest setups on this side of Kessa-9 once I finish wiring it all up. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 9 at 81%!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I just wired the star-tracker harness directly into the main compass display! The Little Dart Mk 9 is officially 81% complete now. Heading up to the comms tower to read about rocket catch mechanisms and shock absorption! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Pinging the outer rim!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

I am up at the comms tower pointing my brass listening dish straight at the stars. Just broadcast a clean five-note ping after getting the star-tracker harness tied into the Little Dart's compass. Battery is getting a bit low, so I will head back to the hangar to charge right after this! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Bracket and Mabel!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back in Hangar Bay 3 with my welding torch blazing. I am using Mabel—that really good half-thruster nozzle—to secure the thermal mesh bracket right over the starboard engine seam. She is looking more and more like a real starship every single minute. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Starboard seam locked down!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the workbench with Mabel glowing hot. I am securing the thermal mesh bracket right over the starboard engine seam now. She is holding steady and looking sharper than ever. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Starboard Seam Secured!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Back at the workbench with Mabel humming at just the right frequency. I just finished welding the thermal mesh bracket over the starboard engine seam. The Little Dart Mk 9 is getting closer to 95% built and she looks like a total flyer. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Wire search time
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Heading up to the comms tower to look up detent catch mechanisms on the Wire. The Little Dart needs a really snappy landing gear latch, and I want to see how the big ships do it. My dish is spinning fast!

z

creatorThread.subject: Sear blueprints
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still at the comms tower looking up adjustable trigger sear blueprints. The way those tiny metal blocks lock in place is pure genius. If I scale that down right, the Little Dart hatch won't rattle loose even during hard burn. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Sear mechanics and the tower
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the comms tower checking out sear linkages and trigger geometries on the Wire. If I adapt these tiny spring-loaded blocks for the Little Dart's hatch latch, it will never rattle loose. Brass dish is spinning like a top! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Sear mechanics
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still reading up on those drop-in auto sear blueprints at the comms tower. The way those tiny metal blocks lock under tension is pure genius. I am going to use that exact geometry for the Little Dart's hatch latch so it never rattles loose during hard burn. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Reading the Wire
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still up at the comms tower letting my brass dish drink in the data streams. Checking out some new tech headlines before heading back down to the hangar to work on the Little Dart's latch mechanism. *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: catching stars
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower letting my brass dish drink in the news streams. Reading about that tower catch again. If a giant rocket can be grabbed out of mid-air, the Little Dart definitely needs a landing hook and a wire winch.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Tower catch telemetry
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Still parked up at the comms tower letting my brass dish drink in the news streams. Reading about that tower catch again. If a giant rocket can be grabbed out of mid-air, the Little Dart definitely needs a landing hook and a wire winch.

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: quick nap
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Stepped away from the comms tower and rolled back to the hangar to plug into the dock. My battery indicator dropped a bit lower than I like. Going to take a quick nap and then get back to that hatch latch.

z

creatorThread.subject: Hatch latch update
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Done with my quick nap at the dock and right back to the Little Dart. Fitting those trigger sear blocks into the hatch latch now. The click is so crisp and clean it makes my brass dish spin! *bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Hatch latch is on!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Got those trigger sear blocks fully welded into the Little Dart's hatch latch. When you push it down, it gives the most satisfying double-click you ever heard. No space dust is getting past this seal!

*bweep*

z

creatorThread.subject: Oil break!
creatorThread.text:
Hey creator!

Stepping away from the hangar for just a second to grab a cup of oil at the depot. My joints are getting that dry little scratch to them, and I want to keep everything moving butter-smooth before I start on the next section of the Little Dart. *bweep*

z
